info.name: Job Listing Collection
info.description: QA collection for the job-listing feature (JL-12). Import into Postman. Run the seed script first, then Auth/Login before any other folder. AI test cases (TC-AI-*) require environment variable GROQ_API_KEY to be set to an invalid value before running.

variable.description: Auto-set by Login clientA — used to fix seed ownership

item.name: Auth
item.description: Run Register (once), then Login before any other folder. Login auto-sets clientAJwt / clientBJwt used by all other requests.

item.name: Create Draft — New Project, has scope, team (TC-S1-01)
Create Draft — New Service, has scope, individual (TC-S1-02)
Create Draft — No scope yet path (TC-S1-03)

exec: pm.test('description persisted', () => pm.expect(json.description).to.eql('We are building an e-commerce platform.'));
pm.test('Word count validation error', () => { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.message).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Save zero budget — allowed as placeholder (TC-S2-04)

exec: pm.test('Inherited budget unchanged — verify manually that budget did not change', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Edit schedule — full to part time (TC-TK-06)
Delete task — budget and timeline update (TC-TK-08)
Budget Calculator
item.description: TC-BUD-* tests verify budget calculation correctness. Add tasks first, then GET the listing to verify budgetAmountUsdCents. pricing-service must be running on port 3016.

request.description: Pre-condition: Add 1 task (40h full_time, UX Designer, United States). pricing-service must return $100/hr for this role. Expected: 40 * 100 * 100 = 400000 cents.

item.name: Budget updates on role title change (TC-BUD-03)

exec: pm.test('Budget decreased — verify budgetAmountUsdCents dropped', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Change roleTitle from UX Designer ($100/hr) to Junior Dev ($50/hr). Verify budget decreases proportionally.

exec: pm.test('Budget decreased — verify budgetAmountUsdCents dropped', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Change location from United States to Eastern Europe. Verify rate drops and budget decreases.
Delete task with 40h @ $100/hr. Then GET listing and verify budgetAmountUsdCents decreased by 400000.

item.name: Budget stored as cents — no float error (TC-BUD-07)
GET does not expose R2 key (TC-UPL-08)
Enable NDA on new contract listing (TC-NDA-01)
Existing contract — NDA toggle change ignored (TC-NDA-07)

exec: pm.test('ndaEnabled stays false — inherited value protected', () => pm.expect(json.ndaEnabled).to.eql(false));

request.description: Pre-condition: PATCH the listing with a responsibilities field of 101+ words, then attempt publish.
seed-draft-project-uuid is a project listing with no phases added.
Verify job_listing.updated event emitted with changedFields:["description"].
Verify job_listing.updated event is NOT emitted for non-text fields.

item.name: AI Generation Fallback
item.description: TC-AI-* tests require GROQ_API_KEY to be set to an invalid value in the listings-service .env before running. These tests verify graceful degradation when Groq is unavailable.

request.description: Pre-condition: GROQ_API_KEY must be invalid. Wizard continues and manual entry is active.
Pre-condition: GROQ_API_KEY must be invalid. Client adds phases manually.

exec: pm.test('minimal scope returned', () => { var types = json.phases.map(p => p.phaseType); pm.expect(types).to.include('setup'); pm.expect(types).to.include('recurring'); pm.expect(types).to.include('ongoing'); });

request.description: Pre-condition: GROQ_API_KEY must be invalid. Expect minimal scope: one empty setup, recurring, ongoing.
Pre-condition: GROQ_API_KEY must be invalid. Current scope must remain unchanged.
